credential_scope: Use frozen complete-PEM/known-format/exact-available-credential scanner; retain candidate digests and source/member path hashes only. Token/header-only test parser constants must not be promoted to complete key matches. Root can classify known public fixture bytes through exact digest and public provenance.

publication_gates.any_unresolved_or_candidate: No universal clean claim; root exact-provenance classification or explicit public quarantine required. Retain all originals locally and preserve digest/path coverage; report dropped-public-content bytes truthfully.
publication_gates.clean_or_explicit_public_provenance: Retain full decode classification receipt tied to exact raw file/shard SHA and scanner source/tools/budgets; root authorizes publication separately.
publication_gates.decoded_secret_found: Fresh publication derivative must physically omit all affected raw file chunks from shard members, not merely omit the file path. Conservative shared-chunk closure may require quarantine of further referencing paths. Original local candidate shards remain private unchanged.

recursion: Inspect decoded stream magic and archive members recursively; never extract member paths into source directories. Member names and links are scanned separately. Binary/text payloads remain opaque and are scanned as byte streams.
selected_inputs: Final path/index manifests and actual opaque-container records from local archive-build-01; archived bytes reconstructed from pinned local shard chunks, not potentially drifted live originals. Exact source reconstruction SHA must match the archived full SHA before positive classification.
split_archives: Explicit ordered group map from generated preservation manifest; concatenate exact CAS bodies in original part order only with recorded group lineage; incomplete groups remain unresolved. Magic-less archive parts must not be assumed non-containers.
unresolved_cases: Depth, byte, member or time bound reached
Reconstructed bytes do not match original archived full SHA
Non-regular archive member metadata with inaccessible contents
